notes.title: Wild Arena Demo
notes.content:
We are preparing a demo of the game and we expect to release it soon on Steam.

The demo will contain the first 10 levels of the game and 2 levels for each mini game.

In total, 16 arenas will be playable.

We hope you enjoy.
